Art-directed case study / Magazine & editorial

An issue driven by imagery and editorial rhythm

Project intention

A fashion editorial built around material, gesture, and the spaces between images. Its most important quality is the change of pace from one feature to the next.

Design decisions

Emphasise the contrast between expressive photography and quieter reading pages instead of treating every spread as a cover.
